description: 2026-10-18, in ./release minor's gate for 0.17.0: crates/muster-daemon/tests/daemon/typing.rs waited 20 s for the second p1's file to hold "z" and found it empty, with the machine's load at 22.2 on 6 performance cores (other agents' jobs and a browser beside the gate's 15). It passed 5/5 alone in under a second and 60/60 run 12 at a time, and the same tree's gate passed an hour earlier. Read as starvation for now. If it comes back at ordinary load, suspect the input path routing a key for a reused name to the closed pane, which is what the test is about.
title: 🎲 keys_for_a_name_reach_the_pane_that_has_it_now timed out at load 22
